notes: isCanonicalSkillPackageChecker verifies canonical source-package markers (package.json name execution-plan-integrity-skill, SKILL.md name execution-plan-integrity, scripts/artifact.mjs, and scripts/validate.mjs) rather than comparing import.meta.url, so globally installed checkers and git worktrees still validate carapace while target-repo duplicates still fail.
scripts/verify.mjs strips NODE_TEST_CONTEXT and NODE_TEST_WORKER_ID when spawning child processes so nested node --test verification calls propagate failing exit codes accurately.
